info.title: kokoro
info.description: Offline text-to-speech on the command line, powered by Kokoro-82M. Speaks text aloud or renders it to a WAV file, with 157 voices across nine languages and on-the-fly voice blending. Model weights and voices are downloaded on first use and cached; nothing leaves your machine.

commands.name: say
commands.description: Speak text aloud, or render it to a WAV file.

options.name: --voice
options.description: Voice name, or a weighted blend like 'af_heart:2,af_bella:1'. [default: af_heart]

options.name: --speed
options.description: Speech rate. 1.0 is normal; useful range is roughly 0.5 to 1.3. [default: 1]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write a 24 kHz mono WAV here instead of playing through the speakers.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model weights to use. The zh_* variants are the Kokoro v1.1 Mandarin release. [default: float32]

options.name: --volume
options.description: Playback volume between 0.0 and 1.0. Ignored when writing to a file. [default: 1]

options.name: --best-quality
options.description: Synthesize the text in one pass instead of streaming it segment by segment. Slower to start, avoids segment-boundary artifacts, and caps input at 510 tokens. [default: False]

options.name: --language
options.description: Filter by language: american-english, british-english, japanese, mandarin-chinese, spanish, french, hindi, italian, brazilian-portuguese.

options.name: --gender
options.description: Filter by speaker gender: male or female.

options.name: --search
options.description: Only show voices whose name contains this text.

options.name: --names-only
options.description: Print bare voice names, one per line, for piping into other commands. [default: False]
